summary: Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. (HHH) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Vantage Group Holdings Ltd. for $2.1 billion in cash via its subsidiary Howard Hughes Insurance Holdings, LLC. The transaction was financed through cash on hand and $1 billion of non-voting preferred equity from Pershing Square Holdings Ltd. (PSH). The board formed a committee of independent directors to approve the financing. The acquisition closed June 4, 2026, with no price adjustment for early closing. Watch for integration of Vantage's insurance operations and regulatory compliance.
